Name: PHP Unsupported Version Detection
Synopsis: The remote host contains an unsupported version of PHP.
Description:
According to its version, the installation of PHP on the remote host
is no longer supported.
Solution: Upgrade to a supported version of PHP.

Name: HTTP Server Type and Version
Description: This plugin attempts to determine the type, "and the version", of the web server.

Name: SSL Medium Strength Cipher Suites Supported (SWEET32)
